text.en: View release notes offline from About app.
text.zh: 在关于应用中离线查看版本更新日志。

text.en: Release history adapts to wide windows with a multi-column waterfall layout.
text.zh: 历史更新根据窗口宽度自适应展示为单列、双列或三列瀑布流。

text.en: Current-version notes and release history now show the same categories and content.
text.zh: 统一关于应用与历史更新的分类和内容展示。

text.en: On unfolded foldables, switch between one column and hinge-aligned columns with a rotating icon.
text.zh: 折叠设备全开时默认单列，点击右上角图标切换铰链分列，图标带旋转过渡。

text.en: Release cards fill their available pane width while preserving hinge clearance.
text.zh: 历史更新卡片铺满所属窗格的可用宽度，并保留铰链避让。

text.en: Keep hinge-aligned release cards stable during predictive back gestures.
text.zh: 修复预测性返回手势导致铰链分列卡片宽度与文字换行变化。

text.en: See what’s new on the first launch of each app version.
text.zh: 每个版本首次启动时弹窗展示本次更新内容。
